**Cumania IV's mock war now shows on the map.** Its two nations (Agartha, Recallia) have cities but no land on the political map, so the war menu had nothing to colour. Their capture limits are now drawn as their territory in the war view, in the colour of whoever holds each city (taken from the war's own map, `AgarthanWar.svg`, then kept up to date from dynmap), with the front lines and rings as usual. (For Minecraft 26.1.x, 26.2 and 26.3.)
